map.内置常见交通违法行为库，勾选违法行为后累计罚款与扣分，并提示记分风险（参考标准，: A built-in library of common traffic violations: tick violations to accumulate fines and demerit points, with a demerit risk warning (reference standards, subject to local regulations).
map.罚款总额 = Σ 各违法行为罚款额；扣分总额 = Σ 各违法记分值（同一记分周期: Total fine = Σ fines of each violation; total demerit = Σ demerit points of each violation (accumulated within one demerit cycle, 12 points requires study and an exam); high risk is triggered when any violation carries 12 points (such as drunk driving or hit and run) or the total reaches 12; common standards are running a red light 6 points and 200 CNY fine, speeding within 20% 3 points, speeding over 50% 12 points, drink driving 12 points plus license suspension; always defer to local traffic authority rules.
map.💡 记分周期内累计 12 分需参加满分学习并重考科目一；累计 24 分及以上需重: 💡 Accumulating 12 points within a demerit cycle requires full-score study and retaking the written test; 24 points or more requires retaking both the written test and the road test; drunk or impaired driving additionally carries license revocation.

map.查看距 12 分还剩多少分，评估驾驶证被扣留的风险。: See how many points remain before 12 and assess the risk of license suspension.
map.识别含吊销驾驶证等严重后果的违法行为（如醉驾、肇事逃逸）。: Identify violations with severe consequences such as license revocation (such as drunk driving or hit and run).
map.累计罚款 = Σ各项罚款；累计记分 = Σ各项记分；距 12 分剩余 = 12: Total fine = Σ fines; total demerit = Σ demerit points; remaining to 12 = 12 − total demerit (shown as exceeded when negative). Risk determination: containing a revocation violation → license revoked and legal liability may apply; demerit ≥24 → retake written + road tests; demerit ≥12 → license detained, full-score study and retake the written test; demerit ≥6 → a reminder to drive carefully; otherwise safe.
map.同时勾选“闯红灯”（罚款 200 元、记 6 分）与“超速 20% 以上未达 5: Ticking "running a red light" (fine 200 CNY, 6 points) and "speeding over 20% but under 50%" (fine 200 CNY, 6 points) together: total fine 400 CNY, demerit 12 points, which exactly triggers license detention, full-score study and retaking the written test. Adding one more violation of 3 points and a 50 CNY fine brings the total to 15 points, still handled as ≥12 (below 24 only the written test is retaken).
map.记分周期为 12 个月（自初次领证之日起），一个周期内未满 12 分且已缴清罚款: The demerit cycle is 12 months (starting from the date the license is first issued); points that stay below 12 in a cycle with all fines paid reset at the end of the cycle, while reaching 12 points requires study and an exam, and refusing to participate results in public notice of suspension.
